competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that increases according to your MAX HP and stuns for 1 turn with a 15% chance.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage by 15% of your MAX HP and steals 1 beneficial effect granted on the target. Leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns if the enemy has no beneficial effects.

The target will receive 25% increased damage.
